final: WITH g AS (SELECT o.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM "order" o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), ov AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM g WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL), gd AS (SELECT g.account_id, g.region, g.cnt, g.cnt - ov.avg_cnt AS diff FROM g JOIN ov ON ov.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL), ra AS (SELECT region, AVG(diff) AS ravg FROM gd GROUP BY region) SELECT gd.account_id, gd.region, gd.cnt, gd.diff, gd.diff - ra.ravg AS diff2 FROM gd JOIN ra ON ra.region = gd.region WHERE gd.diff > ra.ravg ORDER BY diff2 DESC LIMIT 10
